gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve the details of a specific IP Access Control List mapping for a SIP domain so that I can verify its configuration.
gold.ideal: The API should return the details of the specified IP Access Control List mapping, including the mapping SID, domain SID, and account SID.

gold.user: As an administrator, I want to delete an existing IP Access Control List mapping from a SIP domain to ensure that no unauthorized IP addresses can access the service.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the specified IP Access Control List mapping and return a success message.

gold.user: As a network engineer, I want to create a new IP Access Control List mapping for a SIP domain to allow specific IP addresses to access the service.
gold.ideal: The API should create the new mapping and return the SID of the newly created IP Access Control List mapping along with its details.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to list all IP Access Control List mappings for a SIP domain to review which IP addresses are allowed access.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all IP Access Control List mappings associated with the specified SIP domain, including their SIDs and associated IP addresses.
